title: Fed-SpeechLLM: Federated Learning Speech Language Models for Multilingual ASR
abstract: SpeechLLMs show strong promise for multilingual ASR, yet centralized training conflicts with privacy constraints over distributed, linguistically diverse data. This paper presents Fed-SpeechLLM, a federated learning framework for multilingual SpeechLLM-based ASR evaluated on a bilingual English and Italian setting. We study federated optimization under compounded non-IID conditions from acoustic and cross-lingual heterogeneity. Standard FL methods degrade when clients hold language-skewed distributions. Moreover, we propose language-aware gradient aggregation and a sampling clustering-based method to mitigate multilingual imbalance, using selective aggregation of speech encoders and projection layers with a frozen LLM backbone. Results confirm competitive performance against centralized training.
relevance_note: Federated learning for SpeechLLM-based multilingual ASR; ASR only.
